params.1273: Work with other players to collectively improve your smithing output.
params.1292: Increases the rate of Smithing experience gain, and halves the amount of coal required per bar.
params.1274: You may work the Blast Furnace as often as you wish.
params.1275: Talk to the staff at the furnace to learn more.
params.1276: While this is not a combat-based minigame, you may still take damage if you operate the pump incorrectly.
params.1277: Remember to bring sufficient ore and coal to smelt!
params.1278: Your team must collectively have 30 Firemaking, Strength, Agility and Crafting.
params.1279: In addition, if you do not have level 60 Smithing, you must pay 2,500 coins per ten minutes of using the Furnace.
